list.title: Kulembetsa
list.empty: Palibe zolembetsa zomwe zikufanana ndi zosefera izi.

override.title: Admin override
override.hint: Zotulutsa nthawi zonse zimalowetsedwa ndi utsogoleri wanu komanso chifukwa chake - osakhala chete.
override.cancelBookingHint: Kuletsa kumasonyeza kuti kusungitsa malo ndi ntchito yake yathetsedwa, kubwezera umwini wa ogwira nawo ntchito, ndikulola womanga kuti azitsogoleranso.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Kodi mukufuna kusungitsa malo? Ntchito yake yathetsedwanso. Izi zasungidwa ndi dzina lanu ndi chifukwa.

detail.disputeOpen: Mkangano wa umwini uli wotsegukira kwa kasitomala uyu - mnzake wina akuti ndi wawo. Zimaganiziridwa patsamba la Mikangano.

cancellation.title: Kusungitsa kwathetsedwa
cancellation.hint: Kusungitsa ndi ntchito yake zathetsedwa; umwini wantchito wabwereranso ndi mnzake ndipo womanga atha kuyitanitsanso chitsogozochi.

disputes.title: Mikangano ya Mwini
disputes.hint: Wothandizana naye amene kulembetsa kwake kudakanidwa ngati kubwereza akhoza kutsutsana ndi mwini wake wa kasitomala. Unikani mbali zonse ziwiri ndikusankha.

detail.title: Mkangano {{id}}
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} amasunga kasitomala. Mkangano watsekedwa ndipo palibe chomwe chimasintha.
detail.overturnEffect: Chitetezo chobwereza cha {{holder}} chatha tsopano ndipo kasitomala walembetsedwa ku {{partner}} ngati kaundula watsopano.
